_comment: Which character a wiki quest-giver name means, where slugifying cannot say.
The Quests page attributes thirteen board requests to 'Caldarus Human' and
'Seridia Human' — the human forms the two late-game characters take after
their story arcs. Neither string is a character page, so the quests builder
correctly refused to guess and those requests shipped unattributed. The game
files cannot settle it either way: `request_board.toml` states no giver for
any board request. Linking a form to its character is a judgement, so it
lives here, with the wiki's own attribution as the source.
'Seridia Human' maps to `priestess` because that is still her record id —
see curated/vocab/characters.json for why the id has not moved to seridia.
The app-side spoiler veil is unaffected by this file: Caldarus is a veiled
record, so the board withholds his name exactly as every other screen does.
An unlisted giver name is not an oversight — it falls through to the
ordinary slugify-and-validate path in the quests builder.

Caldarus Human.source: wiki:Quests — the six requests' giver column names his human form

Seridia Human.source: wiki:Quests — the seven requests' giver column names her human form
